_note: Reviewed 2026-11-13 on exact master 16.2.18. Any finding NOT listed here fails the gate. Each entry states why it is accepted.

semgrep.why: unlink only on files the vault itself created: 0600 temp files, or paths resolved by locate() from a reference validated by ^hrv_[a-f0-9]{48}$
AES-256-GCM: authentication tag is verified by openssl_decrypt; the result is checked with is_string() and the SHA-256 is compared with hash_equals()

wpcs.why: read-only admin menu redirect keyed on a sanitized page slug; no state change
all five are wpdb->prepare() calls using %i/%d/%s placeholders: line 28 concatenates only the fixed literal ' FOR UPDATE'; lines 547/550 pass a static SQL string
encoding a download body, not code obfuscation
decoding bundled SOP payload; integrity-checked by SHA-256
decoding the key from the Owner-configured keyring
DOCUMENT_ROOT is only passed to realpath() to refuse a vault inside the web root
